translations.web: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
translations.bsb: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
translations.kjv: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
translations.asv: For Jehovah Most High is terrible; He is a great King over all the earth.
